name: Attio monochrome OG social card by attio.com
description: A 1200×630 card built on tension between two anchors: a chained run of five outlined isometric hexagonal prisms with dashed fold lines sits top-right like a packaging dieline or blueprint drawing, while a three-line headline drops down the bottom-left, each line one step lighter in gray until it nearly dissolves into the off-white ground. The wordmark is the only black element bottom-right, anchoring the diagonal flow from headline to logo. Faint dashed grid hairlines at the top-left edge expose the layout grid, giving the whitespace a technical, engineered feel rather than emptiness.
